- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:analyze-commit-notify ~277-300, deep-audit ~884-910, api-redundancy ~1303-1328 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The three build invocations do not set `SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH`, so the wrapper falls back to `${RUNTIME_DIR:-${RUNNER_TEMP:-${PWD}}}/.semble-index`.
  WHY: On runners without a usable `RUNNER_TEMP`, the index can land in the checkout root or hit permission issues instead of a clean temp location.
- scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:108-152 (build_index() heredoc invocation) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `build_index()` and the generated wrapper use different mechanisms to locate the index when `SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH` is unset.
  WHY: The index build passes the path via argv, but query-time fallback depends on a fixed parent-layout assumption, so an unexpected wrapper location can resolve the wrong or nonexistent pickle.
- scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:95-96 (build_index function, rm -rf "${index_path}") | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Cleanup suppresses stderr with `2>/dev/null || true`, hiding why stale-path cleanup failed.
  WHY: That removes operator visibility into permission or ENOENT problems that could explain a later index-write failure.
- tests/test_semble_workflow_parity_contract.py:19-44 (REQUIRED_SNIPPETS, TARGET_WORKFLOWS) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `TARGET_WORKFLOWS` omits workflow-log-analysis.yml despite the PR integrating Semble there.
  WHY: Future regressions in workflow-log-analysis wiring will escape the parity contract checks.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:509/993/1421 (wla_query_text/audit_query_text/api_query_text assignments) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 -c` silently drops invalid bytes from the query slice.
  WHY: Malformed log bytes degrade Semble query quality without any signal that data was discarded.
